authorship: Text and drawing code drafted for Denframe with AI assistance (Claude); a person reviews every pack before it is approved (plan D26).
narration: None. eSpeak NG, the only voice the plan allows (D26), was not installed where the pack was drawn; the cards are text-first and silent.

sources.supports: Phase names and order, the Moon always half lit by the Sun, and the cycle of about 29.5 days.
The two end stars of the Big Dipper's bowl (Dubhe and Merak) point to Polaris, which stays in roughly the same place while other stars circle the pole.
The Summer Triangle: Vega (Lyra), Deneb (Cygnus) and Altair (Aquila).

Every star's J2000 position and V magnitude (the drawings), the Big Dipper and Cassiopeia about 12 hours of right ascension apart round the pole (opposite sides of Polaris), Betelgeuse's red (M) and Rigel's blue-white (B) spectral types. SIMBAD TAP query of the basic and allfluxes tables, 27 September 2026. This research has made use of the SIMBAD database, operated at CDS, Strasbourg, France.

method: SVG drawn by draw.py, rasterised by rsvg-convert, re-encoded by Pillow as an 8-bit palette PNG with no metadata chunks. Original work: no image-generation model, stock or third-party artwork.
